text: zufft computes fast Fourier, cosine sine transforms R. bundles BSD-licensed FFT code ducc0, subset commit SciPy uses, needs system FFTW library carries GPL code. goals, order: Replace fftwtools without FFTW. Install install.packages() alone, permissive licence. Perform like fftwtools. Within 1.5 times speed everywhere, faster prime lengths, many simultaneous transforms threads. easy, familiar API. Function names fftwtools user recognises, conventions scipy.fft axes, normalisation, cosine sine transforms, threads. Status (2026-10-13): yet usable. package built stage stage; see roadmap v0.1.0 issue.

title: zufft: Fast Fourier, Cosine and Sine Transforms with a Bundled 'ducc0' — zufft-package
text: Computes discrete Fourier transforms (complex, real--complex complex--real) discrete cosine sine transforms types one four axes array, 'FFT' code 'ducc0' (https://github.com/mreineck/ducc) bundled 'BSD'-licensed subset 'SciPy' uses, system 'FFTW' library needed. Transforms length run O(n log n) time, real input uses true real transforms, several threads can share one transform. interface follows conventions 'scipy.fft' offers unnormalised inverse 'fftwtools' stats::fft().
